posts.text: California is doing what NO state has ever done before — making our OWN prescription drugs to take on Big Pharma and drive down costs. Insulin, naloxone, and asthma inhalers. EpiPens are next. We’re making lifesaving drugs CHEAPER and more accessible for everyone.

posts.text: A year of pre-school can cost families thousands. In California, we made it FREE. Every 4-year-old now has access to a FULL YEAR of pre-K, saving families $13,000 A YEAR. More money back in parents’ pockets, more opportunity for our kids.

posts.text: Donald Trump wants to put America in reverse. We know what’s at stake and we have to meet this moment.
posts.summary: Trump threatens to reverse progress, Democrats must resist
posts.quote: Donald Trump wants to put America in reverse. We know what’s at stake and we have to meet this moment.

posts.text: Twenty states still have a $7.25 minimum wage while an entire generation feels locked out of the economy. Something is fundamentally broken. Democrats should be the party willing to say it — and bold enough to fix it.
posts.summary: Minimum wage stagnation reflects broken economy, Democrats must address wage inequality
posts.quote: Twenty states still have a $7.25 minimum wage while an entire generation feels locked out of the economy. Something is fundamentally broken. Democrats should be the party willing to say it — and bold enough to fix it.

posts.text: America isn’t left vs. right. It’s top vs. bottom. There is too much money and power concentrated in too few hands. This is the fight that unites people — and the Democratic Party.
posts.summary: Wealth concentration divides top versus bottom, unifying Democratic Party message
posts.quote: America isn’t left vs. right. It’s top vs. bottom. There is too much money and power concentrated in too few hands. This is the fight that unites people — and the Democratic Party.

posts.text: We’re flipping seats from red to blue across the country. KEEP FIGHTING!
posts.summary: Democrats gaining seats, calls for continued electoral mobilization
posts.quote: We’re flipping seats from red to blue across the country. KEEP FIGHTING!

posts.text: Voters want fighters. It’s time for Democrats to fight like hell.
posts.summary: Democrats must aggressively fight for voters and electoral victories

posts.text: Donald Trump does not believe in free and fair elections.
posts.summary: Trump threatens election integrity and democratic process
posts.quote: Donald Trump does not believe in free and fair elections.

posts.text: This is a 25th Amendment moment.  I just watched the ramblings of a mad king and what else can I say — the only thing missing was tin foil.  Donald Trump is trying to rig our elections and we have to stop him. Show up and VOTE this November.
